items.title: Hackers Weaponize Windows Hyper-V to Hide Linux VM and Evade EDR Detection

items.title: Chrome Emergency Update to Patch Multiple Vulnerabilities that Enable Remote Code Execution
items.description: Google has rolled out an urgent security patch for its Chrome browser, addressing five vulnerabilities that could enable attackers to execute malicious code remotely. items.title: APT 'Bronze Butler' Exploits Zero-Day to Root Japan Orgs
items.description: A critical security issue in a popular endpoint manager (CVE-2025-61932) allowed Chinese state-sponsored attackers to backdoor Japanese businesses.
